subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should this PR merge as an adapter-only fix while previously persisted QMD-contaminated recall entries remain unchanged?
rationale: The runtime fix is correct and well-proven, but repairing historical persistent recall state requires an explicit migration-scope and upgrade-safety decision rather than backend-specific parsing in the shared normalizer.

options.title: Accept adapter-only scope
options.body: Merge the clean adapter fix and treat historical stored recall cleanup as separate work only if persistent contamination remains operationally significant.

options.title: Require an owned migration
options.body: Hold the PR until memory-core provides a narrowly scoped migration or repair path for previously stored QMD-derived recall entries.

recommendation.title: Accept adapter-only scope
recommendation.body: Merge the clean adapter fix and treat historical stored recall cleanup as separate work only if persistent contamination remains operationally significant.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository history shows the strongest sustained ownership of the QMD manager and its compatibility behavior.
